create_gluegen_pipeline: create a GlueGenStableDiffusionPipeline with a language adapter to adapt text embeddings for image generation
load_language_adapter: load a pretrained language adapter into a GlueGenStableDiffusionPipeline for prompt embedding transformation
run_image_generation: run the GlueGenStableDiffusionPipeline to generate images from text prompts with classifier-free guidance
encode_prompt_with_adapter: encode text prompts into adapted language embeddings using the GlueGen language adapter
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale noise CFG predictions to fix overexposure using guidance rescale from the Common Diffusion Noise Schedules paper
